description: Read one raw storage slot of a contract on Celo (eth_getStorageAt): the 32-byte word, as a number and, when it holds one, as an address. Slot is a decimal index or a 0x 32-byte key (mapping and proxy slots). Use to inspect contract state that has no getter, owners or implementation pointers; for proxies use celo_proxy. A malformed address or slot is rejected with 400, uncharged. Example: address=0xcebA9300f2b948710d2653dD7B07f33A8B32118C. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

slot.description: Slot: a decimal index (0, 1, 2…) or a 0x 32-byte key

name: celo_storage
title: Storage slot read, Celo
